dataset.note: Multispectral bands B/G/R/NIR/red-edge/LWIR thermal; NDVI and EVI indices evaluated; five crop classes.

mIoU.quote: inclusion of NDVI in CIR input dataset yield high segmentation accuracy of 83.85%
mIoU.ambiguity: Metric reported as 'average segmentation accuracy', computed via Jaccard index (IoU-like), not standard mIoU. Best input CIR+NDVI 83.85%; RGB 83.35%; CIR alone 74.61%.

PA.quote: CIR with NDVI gave most accurate results (83.85% average accuracy highlighted in bold in Table 3) for segregation of crops using U-Net
PA.ambiguity: Averaged per-image overall accuracy with U-Net on CIR+NDVI input (best combination; RGB 83.35%, CIR 74.61%).

study.title: Estimation of Kenaf seedling canopy coverage in saline soil using semantic segmentation of UAV RGB images
study.short_title: SE-U-Net for Kenaf seedling canopy coverage

dataset.name: Kenaf (Hibiscus cannabinus L.) seedlings in saline-alkali soil, UAV RGB
dataset.note: DJI Inspire 2 quadcopter, RGB camera 5472x3648; geometric/radiometric calibration + orthorectification. Image count / altitude / GSD not in extracted text.

mIoU.quote: the U-Net architecture was enhanced by incorporating a Self-Attention (SE) channel mechanism, further improving model performance to achieve an IoU of 85.99% and a Dice of 92.44%
mIoU.ambiguity: Binary (Kenaf seedling vs soil) IoU 85.99% with SE-U-Net; FCN/U-Net/DeepLabV3+ compared. 'Dice' reported alongside IoU.

F1.quote: SE-UNet AdamW ... F1-score 92.44
F1.section: 4.3 / Table 4 (also abstract, where it is mislabeled 'Dice')
F1.ambiguity: F1-score column of Table 4 for SE-UNet AdamW (average over classes). The abstract calls the same value 'an Dice of 92.44%'; for binary segmentation F1 == Dice, recorded under F1. Ablations (Table 5): scale only 91.91, geometric 92.07, photometric 92.17.

Dice.quote: an IoU of 85.99% and a Dice of 92.44%

PA.quote: Replacing SGD with AdamW further enhanced SE-UNet's performance, achieving an overall mIoU improvement of 1.7%, accuracy gain of 1.01%, and mF1-score increase of 0.99%
PA.ambiguity: Overall Accuracy (Acc = (TP+TN)/(TP+TN+FP+FN)) for SE-UNet AdamW, 92.92%. SE-UNet SGD 92.55%; U-Net SGD 91.91% (per-class Acc U-Net: Kenaf 92.33 / Background 91.49).

edge.device: None - offline experiments on a high-performance workstation (13th-gen Intel Core i5-13490F, 64 GB DDR4, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070; Python 3.8, CUDA 11.3, PyTorch 1.10). FCN noted as fastest inference for real-time/resource-limited applications, but no embedded deployment or inference FPS reported.
edge.framework: PyTorch 1.10 / CUDA 11.3 / Python 3.8 (Miniconda3); FCN/U-Net/DeepLabv3+/SE-UNet, ResNet-101 ImageNet init; 40,000 max iterations, SGD (lr 2.5e-3) or AdamW (lr 1e-4), PolyLR; inputs cropped/cropped-to-512x512 for training, sliding-window + TTA at inference

study.title: EDM-UNet: An Edge-Enhanced and Attention-Guided Model for UAV-Based Weed Segmentation in Soybean Fields
study.short_title: EDM-UNet: An Edge-Enhanced and Attention-Guided Model for UAV-Based Weed Segmentation

dataset.name: Self-built UAV soybean field weed dataset
dataset.note: Soybean fields with complex weed interference; evaluated under different weed-interference degrees.

mIoU.quote: the EDM-UNet method achieves the best performance effect on the self-built dataset, and the MIoU, Recall and Precision on the test set reach 89.45%, 93.53% and 94.78% respectively

edge.framework: PyTorch 1.10, Ubuntu 20.04, CUDA 11.3/CUDNN 8.2.0; SGD lr 0.01 momentum 0.937, cosine annealing (decay 0.0005), batch 16, 300 epochs; GPU NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti 12G; FPS = mean of 100 forward passes
